category: file host (free upload, premium day passes)

free_tier.stated: Uploading and downloading are free for all users, including without an account; free or non-account files are kept 90 days and each file must be under 1 GB.

per_object_cap.stated: 1 GB per file for free or non-account uploads; 10 GB per file on premium

retention.stated: 90 days for free or non-account files; unlimited on premium

egress.terms: Premium is sold as a pass: $1.99 for 1 day, $9.99 for 1 month, $30.99 for 6 months, $99.99 forever; it removes waiting, ads and speed limits. No download volume figure is published on the pages read.

interface_detail: Web upload form with a no-registration route; no API page was read.
tooling: Browser upload; premium links resolve through any debrid service that lists the host. No API or client is documented on the pages read.
chaining: A 1 GB-per-file anonymous drop with a 90-day clock; the cheapest paid access is a $1.99 one-day pass.

limits.value: 1 GB per file for free or non-account uploads; 10 GB on premium
free or non-account files are kept 90 days

binding_note: The 1 GB per-file ceiling stops anything larger before retention or speed matter.

identity_cost.detail: Upload works without registering; a registered account is created with an email address, to which the password is sent. Premium is paid through an on-site payment selector.

reliability_note: No status page; the free tier is ad-supported and files expire after 90 days.
confidence_note: Limits and prices read on the vendor FAQ and upgrade pages. Download speed on the free tier and the payment methods behind the selector are unread.

evidence.quote: Each file you upload must be less than 1 GB in size for free/non accounts or less than 10 GB in size for premium accounts.
evidence.proved: the free or non-account cap is 1 GB per file, 10 GB on premium

evidence.quote: Free/non accounts files are kept for 90 days. Premium accounts files are kept for unlimited days.
evidence.proved: free retention is 90 days, premium is unlimited

evidence.quote: Starting from just $1.99 for a 1 day access pass, RapidShare is one of the most affordable file hosts in the universe!!!
evidence.proved: the cheapest paid tier is a $1.99 one-day pass
uploads are possible without an account
